detail: WPC80:micellar casein 60:40: Whey gives rise/structure, casein holds water and slows setting → fudgy, non-rubbery; lowest-risk texture.
WPC80:MPC70 50:50 (or WPC80:SMP 65:35): MPC/SMP replaces costly imported casein; adds milk flavour (great for rasmalai/gulab jamun).
WPC80:WPI:casein 45:15:40: WPI lifts protein % without volume; casein ≥35-40% essential at high protein to avoid sponge-rubber.
Pea isolate:brown rice 60:40 (+ optional 10-20% soy isolate): Complementary amino acids (PDCAAS ~0.9+), rice softens pea gel; add 15-20% more liquid.
WPC80:sattu (pure chana) 70:30: Sattu lowers cost and adds roasted Indian flavour; keep sattu ≤30% to avoid dense crumb.
Protein powders 35-45% of dry mix; GF flours (almond+rice/millet) 30-35%: Above ~50% protein powder the matrix behaves like a set omelette → rubbery; flour starch/fat interrupts protein network.
Keep protein powders ≤45% of dry mix; above ~50% the heat-set protein network (no starch/fat interruption) turns spongy-rubbery.
Always pair whey with a water-holding protein (casein/MPC) at ≥35-40% of total protein; whey alone dries out when microwaved (thebigmansworld advises casein/pea over pure whey).
Add tenderisers: fat (almond flour, fat powder, or 1 tsp oil/ghee by user), humectants (allulose, inulin, jaggery) which hold water and lower firmness.
Microwave is the #1 rubber cause: instruct 60 s first, then 10 s bursts; pull while centre is slightly glossy; 1 min rest finishes it via carryover. Print wattage table on pack (700/900/1100 W).
Air fryer: 150°C max with allulose/jaggery/milk powder (fast Maillard browning); foil cover after half-time; use a ramekin ≤ half full.
Pressure cooker: no whistle/weight, stand + water, covered bowl so condensate doesn't drip; 12-17 min.

Eggless leavening: 2-2.5 g double-acting GF baking powder per 50-60 g mix + 0.2 g soda when cocoa/fruit acids present; double-acting is important because some rise happens before cooking while user mixes.
Binders replacing egg/gluten: psyllium 1-1.5 g (moisture, crumb cohesion) + xanthan 0.1-0.2 g; more makes gummy. Whey/WPC also partially acts as egg replacer (Arla).

Sweeteners: erythritol for bulk (≤12 g/serve to limit cooling effect and laxation); allulose gives moisture + browning but is 70% sweetness and pricey in India (check FSSAI permission status for allulose before launch—historically not listed as approved); stevia 0.03-0.05 g Reb-A, avoid more (bitter). Jaggery for Indian SKUs (adds iron/flavour, but counts as added sugar on label).
Let batter rest 1-2 min after mixing so psyllium/casein hydrate—smoother, less gritty crumb.
Use agglomerated/instantised proteins for lump-free mixing with a spoon.

Water activity: target finished dry mix aw <0.30 (moisture <5%) to prevent baking powder pre-reaction, caking, and Maillard browning/staleness of whey; jaggery and FD fruit are hygroscopic—use dried/encapsulated grades.

Shelf life: 9-12 months achievable at aw<0.3 in high-barrier pack; main failure modes are fat oxidation (almond flour, fat powder) → use rosemary extract/mixed tocopherols and nitrogen flush; lysine loss/browning in whey + reducing sugars (jaggery, milk powder) at Indian ambient (30-40°C, high RH)—run accelerated tests at 38°C/90% RH.

Packaging: single-serve sachet in PET12/Alu-foil 9 µm/PE 50-70 (or PET/MetPET/PE minimum) — WVTR <0.1 g/m²/day and OTR <1 cc/m²/day; nitrogen flush (residual O2 <3%); heat seal integrity tests; option for in-pack paper cup/silicone mug for 'Bake-in-the-cup' variant (must be microwave & 160°C safe).

Label: gluten-free claim in India needs <20 ppm gluten (FSSAI); source certified-GF rice/jowar/ragi flours and pure chana sattu; test each batch (ELISA R5). Declare milk, tree nut (almond, pistachio), soy allergens. Use green veg dot (no egg).
Protein claim: FSSAI 'source of protein' ≥10% RDA per 100 g, 'high protein' ≥20% of energy from protein — all formulations here exceed 25% energy from protein.

BĀK Goods (USA) sells single-serve gluten-free microwave protein cake mixes, 35 g+ protein per mix (Pumpkin Spice 36 g), US$6.99 each; flavours Cinnamon Roll, Deep Chocolate, Strawberry Cream, Vanilla Bean, Cranberry Orange, Pumpkin Spice (LTO); claims no added sugar, no artificial dyes, ready in under 3 min ('mix, cook, enjoy'). Full ingredient lists are NOT published on the homepage and none were found in public search results; our formulations infer a whey/casein + nut-flour + non-nutritive-sweetener base typical of the category. BĀK's 35 g implies a larger (~70-80 g) serve vs our 50-60 g sachet; our PRO tier delivers ~20 g at ~60 g.
